Enregistrer la décision au dossier: Record the decision on the case
Joindre le document au dossier: Attach the document to the case
Commencer par le panneau « Pré-vérificat: Start with the « Pre-check » panel of the case: accept or dismiss each finding (those marked « AI » are indicative). Check the request, then grant, refuse or ask for more information. A second request for the same vehicle is refused at creation (uniqueness key). Without a decision within 30 days, the permit is granted automatically.
Le demandeur a reçu par e-mail la motiva: The applicant received by e-mail the reasons entered at review (the information expected). Enter their reply and add the documents received to the case. Without a reply within 30 days, the request is refused automatically.
Le gestionnaire a besoin d'informations: The case officer needs more information to review your resident parking permit request. Answer below and attach the relevant documents (registration certificate, proof of address). Without a reply within 30 days, the request will be refused.
Vérifier la demande, puis autoriser, ref: Check the request, then grant, refuse or ask for more information. A second request for the same vehicle is refused at creation (uniqueness key). Without a decision within 30 days, the permit is granted automatically.
